text:
incident-bot: ALERT 1948008765 - GPU pool 'east-1-primary' at 98% allocation, queue length spiking > 12k reqs. severity: P1. Auto-scaler reports failed scale due to 'quota_exceeded' errors. Paging oncall.

sara: got it — I'm oncall. seeing large tail of short requests and steady ramp from a handful of customers. Latency p50 ~ 220ms, p95 ~ 2.4s, p99 ~ 8.7s. Reject rate increasing (429s).

devon: I'm paged. is this a single pool issue or whole region?

sara: east-1-primary GPUs are saturated; east-1-secondary has spare capacity but routing didn't spillover because routing policy still respects "strict_affinity" for a set of customers (enterprise tenants). Some requests are failing before fallback kicks in.

mike: looking at autoscaler logs — saw repeated calls to cloud quota API failing with 403: "project quota limit reached for nvidia-t4". The autoscaler retried and then aborted; error path doesn't trigger emergency-burst if quota error.

infra-bot: metric snapshot:
```n
pool: east-1-primary
alloc: 98%
queued_requests: 12456
avg_inflight_per_gpu: 10.2
autoscaler_attempts: 6
last_autoscale_error: quota_exceeded
cross_region_spillover_rate: 6%
```n

anita: customer-success flagged 3 customers seeing timeouts (25-40% of their requests). CS opened tickets and asked for ETA.

nate: can we force routing to secondary region for non-enterprise tenants? I can flip a feature-flag to relax affinity.

sara: yes, can we target only "non-sla" routes? Need to avoid moving enterprise traffic without approval.

mike: I can kick a manual fallback via the routing control plane: set route policy for region_failover = "allow" for the matching frontend rules. That will push new traffic to east-1-secondary/central-1. But we need to ensure model variants exist there (quantized variant available?).

ops-bot: runbook suggest_step: manual_routing_override -> apply for 15m -> monitor error rates -> revert.

sara: ok applying manual override now for routes: /v1/generate (non-enterprise) and /v1/embeddings (non-enterprise).

sara: command: 
``
# routingctl set-fallback --selector "tenant_tier!=enterprise" --regions east-1-secondary,central-1 --ttl 900
``

mike: confirming model variant presence: central-1 has quantized-v2, east-1-secondary has quantized-v1. There will be small quality delta for some prompts but acceptable as mitigation.

devon: after override, queue in east-1-primary dropped from 12.4k to 3.1k within 2m. cross-region ingress to east-1-secondary jumped by ~18k rps.

infra-bot: new metric snapshot:
```n
pool: east-1-primary
alloc: 87%
queued_requests: 3210
p50 latency: 210ms
p95 latency: 1.6s
p99 latency: 5.1s
cross_region_spillover_rate: 29%
```n
anita: sending initial customer update: "We are routing non-SLA traffic to secondary regions to restore performance. Enterprise customers are isolated and not impacted by this change; we're monitoring quality regressions and will update in 30 min." :thumbsup:

customer-success: added customers: #3456, #9981, #2245 to the incident notes. two of them are on free tier, one on standard — all saw degraded throughput.

mike: note on autoscaler root cause: cloud provider quota leak from a scheduled capacity-refresh earlier that failed to deallocate ephemeral GPUs in a previous job; need follow-up with infra to clear stale quotas and request quota increase for T4 pool. Filed infra ticket INFRA-4821.

devon: handoff to night shift in 40m. Sara — can you summarize action items for the handoff?

sara: sure. action items: [1] routing override in place (non-enterprise -> secondary/central); [2] monitor p99 and queue every 5m; [3] infra ticket INFRA-4821 for quota cleanup and temporary quota bump; [4] CS notified affected customers; [5] prepare rollback plan if quality regressions > 3% for key evals.

nate: adding automated watchers: run evals against sample promptset every 5m on central-1 vs east-1-primary and post diffs to #model-regressions. If quality divergence > threshold, we'll rollback routing override.

ops-bot: eskill - temp-burst policy applied: add 6 ephemeral gpus to east-1-secondary (if quotas permit) — status: pending (awaiting quota approval).

sara: handoff note for night oncall (devon -> night-team):
"We triggered manual region failover for non-enterprise routes due to autoscaler quota_exceeded. Primary pool relieved. Autoscaler failed because of cloud quota; infra ticket opened. Monitor queue, latencies, and quality diffs. If secondary shows errors or model mismatch, revert routing and escalate to infra lead. Customer updates sent."

devon: leaving the incident to night-team. I'm putting a major-incident marker and linking INFRA-4821 and CS tickets in the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident 1948008765 status: mitigated -> partial_mitigated. followup required.

sara: closing loop for now. will watch through the evening. cya. :wave:
